verdict.rationale: Beamer's only documented AI feature is generating changelog post content, which is AI authoring rather than AI-generated insights or suggestions from user data. Its analytics (views, clicks) and NPS trend identification are manual, non-AI reporting features. These are adjacent capabilities, so they earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
